title: Shared store: profiles.json
description: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Wheelkit\store\profiles.json: the profiles, the shared cockpit and which profile each game uses. Wheelkit is its only writer; mods read it. It is Wheelkit's mapping-profiles.json (schema 2) plus Cockpit and Games. Files only gain fields and readers ignore fields they do not know, so no object here sets additionalProperties to false (docs/STORE.md).

Schema.description: Always 2. It never changes: the file only gains fields.

ActiveId.description: The profile Wheelkit has selected for editing, and the one a game without an assignment uses.

Cockpit.description: The one screen layout and measurements every profile uses unless it sets its own Rig.Screens. Null: none saved; each mod keeps its own screen settings.

Games.description: Which profile each game uses, by the game's dbce-mod.json id. An object per game so it can gain fields.

Profile.description: A profile Id. An Id that names no profile falls back to ActiveId.

entry.description: One profile: a whole setup, copied rather than inherited (Wheelkit's MappingPreset).

Name.description: Written by Wheelkit as a copy of Profile.Name; readers use Profile.Name.

Bindings.description: Action id (docs/controls-contract.md section 1) to binding, in file order.

rig.description: The profile's other settings (Wheelkit's RigProfile). Mods read FfbStrength, FfbOn and Screens; Wheelkit owns the rest.

FfbStrength.description: Steering strength; null is the default 50 (art of rally at 50 is the reference, STD-021).

Screens.description: This profile's own screens, overriding Cockpit (for example a Widescreen profile with one screen). Null: the profile uses Cockpit.

Games.description: Wheelkit's per-game overrides inside this profile.

screens.description: Screen layout and measurements (Wheelkit's ScreenSetup). A missing field has the default shown.

MeasuredWidthMm.description: Measured visible width; null derives it from the diagonal.
